Summary:

NEW Spacious Seacrest Home with private Heated Pool- Private Beach - 6 Bikes - `Hidden Gem`



The Space:

🏖 Hidden Gem – Luxury Seacrest Home with Private Pool & Lagoon Pool Access!



✨ QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:

✔ Brand New Home – Modern design & high-end coastal finishes

✔ Private Pool (Heat Option Available) – $50/day (October 1 - May 1) – Not guaranteed

✔ 6 Adult Bikes Included – Explore Seacrest, Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach

✔ Expansive Outdoor Living Spaces – Gas grill, outdoor flatscreen TV & ample seating

✔ 4 Master Bedrooms – Each with King bed & private en-suite bath

✔ Fun Bunk Room + XL Hall Bunks – Perfect for kids & extra guests

✔ Open-Concept Living & Kitchen Area – Fully stocked kitchen & large dining space

✔ 12,000 Sq. Ft. Community Lagoon Pool – Resort-style pool just minutes away

✔ Free Beach Tram Service – Seasonal tram for easy beach access

✔ Shops, Boutiques & Restaurants Within Walking Distance – Prime location in Seacrest Beach

✔ Wi-Fi & Smart TVs Throughout – Stay connected & entertained

✔ Driveway Parking for 4 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient

✔ Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experience



🏠Welcome to Hidden Gem



Hidden Gem is a newly built home in the heart of Seacrest and is everything you'll need for the perfect getaway! Seacrest neighborhood offers amazing shopping, dining, and beautiful views. Take a bike ride through the cobble-stone streets and soak in this beautiful area on 30A. You will find tram stops throughout the neighborhood offering you free transportation to and from the beach along with a world class 12,000 sq community pool. If you are looking for your dream vacation home than look no further.

As you walk in the home you will find a wide-open floor plan with views of the back patio and private heated pool. After a long day at the beach come back and cook your favorite meal in the fully stocked kitchen. This is the perfect place to enjoy time with friends and family with a large kitchen island, a dining table with built in seating, and spacious living area. As you enter the living area you will find plenty of places to kick back and relax with sights of the private back patio. This space offers a gas grill and tons of seating making it easy to enjoy watching your favorite team on the outdoor flatscreen TV while the kids play in the private pool.

There are 4 master bedrooms (yes, 4 master bedrooms) each with a King bed and private bath, and one additional bunk room that has its own bathroom and a set of XL hall bunks. This house is perfect for a multi-family retreat or a family getaway! Come unwind and relax in this beautiful home and go explore all that Seacrest Beach and 30A have to offer.





House Rules

**No Pets!**

**No Smoking!**

**No Parties!**

**The primary renter must be at least 25 years old**

**No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25**

**30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**





Pool Heat

*Pool heat available for this property from October 1st through May 1st

*Fee $50 per day and required for length of stay

*Pool heat is not guaranteed-please note pool and hot tub cannot be heated at the same time.

*Please choose to heat one option; pool or hot tub for your stay.





*No Cable. Streaming Only**



** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.**





SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (16):

Master 1: King bed with private bath, stand up shower

Master 2: King bed with private bath, stand up shower

Master 3: King bed with private bath, stand up shower

Guest 4: 4 Twin sized beds, private bath tub/shower combo

Guest 5: King bed and queen bed with private bathroom with stand up shower

First Floor Common Area: XL twin over twin built in hall bunk beds



AREA ATTRACTIONS:

Seacrest is an ideal place for families and people of all ages. Walk the cobble-stone streets in the Seacrest neighborhood, bike along scenic 30-A, enjoy free concerts and outdoor movies, dine at casual and gourmet restaurants, and let the kids run off to the ice cream parlor or candy store.

Seacrest hosts Camp Creek Lake, meaning that ecosploring opportunities abound. Rare bird species can be found along the borders of the lake, which is surrounded by walking trails and made up of a mix of salt and fresh water.

This quaint beach neighborhood regularly welcomes new shops and restaurants. Recently opened establishments, like Acme Ice House, add an exciting twist to the Seacrest dining scene while long-time favorites, like Seacrest Sundries and LaCocina, keep regulars coming back for more.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: Spent a week at the Hidden Gem with our family of 12. Pros:- A king bed and bathroom in each bedroom was a hit!- We were allowed to check in early.- Communication was quick with all of our concerns. - Hot tub heated up extremely quick. Cons:- Main living area had limited seating for our entire party. We had to use our beach chairs to give everyone a seat.- Living room furniture was old and very used. - Stairwell and walls had marks and scuffs. - Bikes were not in working order, but we found out the hard way while on a bike-ride. Bikes were eventually traded out. - We paid for the pool to be heated and it took a couple of days into our stay for it to get to 87. Very frustrating.
